meta.subject: Bahasa Melayu
meta.official_reference: KPM Format Instrumen Pentaksiran Ujian Akhir Sesi Akademik Menengah Rendah (Tingkatan 1, 2 dan 3) Tahun 2025
meta.design_rule: Assessment mapping is kept separate from curriculum mastery. A paper provides evidence for selected skills; it does not define the whole KSSM curriculum.

mapping_principles: Map each detected UASA item to one or more curriculum micro-skills after reading the actual question, not merely by section name.
Preserve item-level correctness, marks, question type and evidence confidence.
Use repeated evidence across papers to estimate mastery; never convert one UASA score directly into official PBD TP.
Written UASA evidence must not be used to infer oral pronunciation/intonation performance unless the official instrument or teacher evidence directly assesses it.
Keep current-year instrument format versioned because assessment specifications can change independently of the DSKP.
cross_form_use: T1-T3 UASA evidence feeds the same longitudinal student profile and may trigger prerequisite backtracking across forms.
